prediction_question: Hypothetical task this source would support (not taken forward): for an IMD observation station, will the next day's rainfall (or temperature) exceed a documented threshold, given the station's own history through day D? Named as a tick source (India: IMD) and probed to a verdict rather than left on the bench.
prediction_time: Would be 23:59 IST on day D: station history through D knowable, day D+1 observations not yet made.
target_definition: Would be mechanical from the station's own D+1 observation series (rainfall mm or temperature) against a documented IMD threshold; the label source is the D+1 series itself, which would be excluded from shipped columns.

license_evidence: Measured 2026-10-20: both IMD public portals fail at connection level from the coordinator (curl HTTP 000, twice), so no IMD page could be read first-hand this session; everything recorded about the DSP comes from search-engine reads of dsp.imdpune.gov.in pages. measurements.unreachable_2026_10_20: curl to https://mausam.imd.gov.in/ and https://dps.imd.gov.in/: HTTP 000 (connection failure) from the coordinator, two attempts each, 2026-10-20 - possibly network/geo filtering of this host; a worker in another region may see otherwise.
measurements.dsp_policy_2026_10_20: dsp.imdpune.gov.in pages (read via web search): 'Free Data Access' carries aggregate/gridded products only; station-level observation data (hourly rainfall, temperature, humidity, wind, pressure - the Data Supply list) is procured through enrolment, request forms and (for non-MoES users) data charges.
measurements.reachable_2026_10_28: Both IMD public hosts now answer from the coordinator (2026-10-10-20 finding stale): https://mausam.imd.gov.in/ HTTP 200, 229,231 bytes, 2.2 s; https://dsp.imdpune.gov.in/home_freedataaccess.php HTTP 200, 45,490 bytes, 2.0 s. No worker probe is needed for reachability.
measurements.free_inventory_2026_10_28: IMD-DSP 'Free Data Access' page read directly from the publisher's own instrument: exactly three free products - All India Monthly and Seasonal Mean Temperature Series, All India Monthly and Seasonal Rainfall, Frequency of Cyclonic Systems in Indian Ocean Region (all national aggregates; the page says the same info is on data.gov.in). No station-level series is free; enrolment + charges policy unchanged on the same page. mausam.imd.gov.in enumerated: forecast/bulletin/GIS portal only; the station-rainfall page (responsive/rainfall_page_station_rainfall.php, 53,057 bytes) is a static shell with no data form or AJAX endpoint.

rejection_reason: PARK (status parked), re-evaluated 2026-10-28. The network part of the original blocker is resolved (both portals HTTP 200 from the coordinator; measurements updated), and the free-product inventory is now enumerated from the publisher's own pages: the free list is three national aggregate series (all-India monthly/seasonal temperature, all-India rainfall, cyclonic-system frequency) and contains NO station-level product; station-level historical observation series remain enrolment-gated and chargeable per the DSP Version 4.0 note on the same page. The product this bench's task shapes need is not available without procurement. This is now a procurement/licence decision, not a probe question: stays parked pending an operator decision on paid enrolment.

Cheap quarterly watch trigger: one GET to https://dsp.imdpune.gov.in/home_freedataaccess.php - reopen only if a station-level product appears in the free list, and then read the licence terms before any advance.
